customer_question.en: Can my Archer AX20 do mesh?
customer_question.ms: Archer AX20 saya boleh buat mesh ke?

symptoms: Customer wants to add a mesh unit to an AX20
diagnostic_questions: Which hardware version is printed on the label (for example V1, V2, V3)?
decision_rules: V3: EasyMesh supported (official excerpt)
V2: EasyMesh not supported (community only)
V1/V1.2: conflicting, escalate
Other: check EasyMesh product list, unverified
troubleshooting_steps: Read the hardware version from the label
Compare with the version table
records.expected_result: Customer knows whether the AX20 version supports EasyMesh
fallback_steps: Escalate if the version is V1 or unknown
warnings: OneMesh, EasyMesh, Deco and Omada do not interoperate
Never ask for or accept Wi-Fi passwords, administrator passwords, label credentials or one-time codes.
escalation_conditions: Hardware version V1 or not in the table
records.source_title: Archer AX20 firmware release notes and TP-Link community replies

customer_question.en: How do I set my AX20 as an access point?
customer_question.ms: Macam mana nak set AX20 jadi access point?

symptoms: Customer wants to use the AX20 behind an existing router
diagnostic_questions: Which router stays as the main router?
Which hardware version?
decision_rules: Steps sourced for V1 only; other versions unverified
troubleshooting_steps: Sign in to the router web page
Advanced > System > Operation Mode > Access Point > Save
Wait for the reboot
Connect the AX20 to the existing router with an Ethernet cable
Open http://tplinkwifi.net, then Advanced > Quick Setup
records.expected_result: AX20 broadcasts Wi-Fi and clients get internet from the main router
fallback_steps: If Operation Mode is missing, firmware may be old (community); escalate
warnings: Parental Controls, QoS and NAT Forwarding are not available in AP mode (FAQ 3774)
Which AX20 port connects to the main router is unverified
Never ask for or accept Wi-Fi passwords, administrator passwords, label credentials or one-time codes.

customer_question.en: How do I add a mesh unit?
customer_question.ms: Macam mana nak tambah unit mesh?

diagnostic_questions: Which unit is the main router?
Is the new unit brand new or reset?
Can you place it next to the main router for setup?
decision_rules: Methods in order: Ethernet, WPS, Aginet app, web UI
App scanning works only between TP-Link ISP-customised models
troubleshooting_steps: Check EasyMesh is enabled on the main router (Advanced > EasyMesh)
Place the agent next to the main router
Ethernet: main router LAN to agent WAN; wait for the agent's internet light
Or WPS: press the main router's WPS about 2 seconds, then the agent's within 2 minutes
Or Aginet app: + > Add Agent > Add as Agent > Done
Or web UI: Basic > Mesh or Advanced > Wireless > Mesh > Add Mesh Device
records.expected_result: Agent appears in the network map and its internet light is on
fallback_steps: Update firmware, disable Guest Wi-Fi and Multi-SSID, retry (FAQ 4758)
Reset the agent only, then retry
warnings: A factory reset erases all settings on that unit, including Wi-Fi name, mesh pairing and ISP settings. Reset only the satellite unless BBTech advises otherwise.
Never ask for or accept Wi-Fi passwords, administrator passwords, label credentials or one-time codes.
records.source_title: How to build Easymesh network with TP-Link customized models (FAQ 4368)

customer_question.en: How to make my second Kaon a mesh?
customer_question.ms: Macam mana nak jadikan Kaon kedua sebagai mesh?

diagnostic_questions: Has the second unit been set to Bridge (AP/Repeater)?
Can you run a LAN cable between the units?
decision_rules: Option 1 Ethernet is recommended; Option 2 WPS without cable
troubleshooting_steps: Keep units 1 to 2 m apart
On the second unit, sign in with the details on its own label (do not share them)
Network > WAN Mode > Bridge (AP/Repeater), enter a friendly name, Apply; unit reboots
Option 1: yellow LAN to yellow LAN, power both, wait for WPS lights
Option 2: press WPS on both for about 1 to 2 seconds, wait for WPS lights
records.expected_result: Second unit's internet light comes on (community observation)
fallback_steps: Reset the second unit only: hold the rear reset button more than 8 seconds, then repeat
warnings: A factory reset erases all settings on that unit, including Wi-Fi name, mesh pairing and ISP settings. Reset only the satellite unless BBTech advises otherwise.
Pairing with non-Maxis routers is unreliable (community)
Never ask for or accept Wi-Fi passwords, administrator passwords, label credentials or one-time codes.
escalation_conditions: Fails after one reset of the second unit
records.source_title: How to setup as EasyMesh WiFi 6 (AR2140), Maxis

customer_question.en: How to set second Huawei Wi-Fi 6 as EasyMesh?
customer_question.ms: Macam mana nak set Huawei Wi-Fi 6 kedua jadi EasyMesh?

symptoms: Second unit does not switch to bridge mode
diagnostic_questions: Did you open the second unit's web page after powering it on?
decision_rules: If the web page was opened, power cycle and do not open it again
troubleshooting_steps: Power on both units 1 to 2 m apart
Do not open the second unit's web page
Hold the second unit's WLAN/WPS button more than 10 seconds, then release
Press the main router's WLAN/WPS button 1 to 2 seconds; its WLAN light blinks
Wait: second unit restarts with all lights off, switches to bridge mode
records.expected_result: Second unit's Internet light stays steady
fallback_steps: Repeat once after a power cycle
warnings: Opening the web page after power-on stops the switch to bridge mode (Maxis manual)
Never ask for or accept Wi-Fi passwords, administrator passwords, label credentials or one-time codes.
records.source_title: How to use Wi-Fi 6 Router as Wi-Fi 6 EasyMesh (LG-8245-X6), Maxis
